custom_logic_notes: Core logic: Identifies candle shadow (wick) rejection patterns on the previous completed bar. A long lower shadow relative to body indicates bullish rejection (hammer-like); a long upper shadow indicates bearish rejection (shooting-star-like). The shadow must significantly exceed the body (configurable ratio). EMA trend filter (8/21 crossover) ensures entries align with the prevailing trend direction. ATR-based SL is placed beyond the candle extreme (low for longs, high for shorts) with ATR multiplier buffer.
python_conversion_notes: Candle shadow pattern is pure price-action logic - trivially computed from OHLC data. iMA and iATR map directly to pandas-ta or ta-lib equivalents. ATR-based SL/TP requires per-bar ATR value multiplied by user-defined factors. New bar detection uses timestamp comparison - implement via bar index increment check. Digit adjustment (5-digit brokers) requires _Point/_Digits awareness when converting pip inputs to price distances. Spread filter uses SymbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_ASK)-SymbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_BID). No custom indicators or external libraries needed.
